assumptions.depth: Photon-weighted flat-throughput blackbody band 2.9-5.1 micron; Tbrightness=1.1*Teq; not atmospheric spectrum or ETC model
assumptions.geometry: Fixed circular representative geometry. Dated 2025-08-13 composite archive ratios and a/Rstar; inclinations checked against live NASA default 2026-10-09; periods from accepted PID10786 APT. Composite values can mix literature solutions. No orbit uncertainty or eccentricity recovery.
assumptions.noise: User-authorized white noise scenarios at 50 and 100 ppm per ideal 60 second bin; not ETC prediction
assumptions.purpose: WASP12 longitudegridconvergence check; original1degree predeclared mainstudy is retained. Same seedposition must be preserved asoriginaltargetindex5.
assumptions.realizations: 100 saved draws per target, using the preserved seed_target_index values. All saved draws are included; no trial is selected by fit outcome.
assumptions.science: Band brightness hot spot longitude, not pressure-specific temperature offset or phase-curve peak; profile-grid screening, not full NUTS validation.
assumptions.trend: delta=atan(tan(40 degrees)*(1500 K/Teq)^3). Illustrative radiative/advection scaling inspired by Showman2020; normalization chosen for simulation, not extracted GCM prediction.
assumptions.visit: Symmetric continuous visit about eclipse, length equals APT total science exposure seconds. Ideal 60-second bins with no gaps; not measured timestamps.
